description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeManager's extractCommand method, specifically testing its behavior with wake word segments and transcripts.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManagerExtractCommandTests
classes.description: A test suite for VoiceWakeManager's extractCommand method, verifying its handling of different transcript scenarios.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNoTriggerFound
methods.description: Tests that extractCommand returns nil when no wake trigger is present in the transcript.

methods.name: extractCommandTrimsTokensAndResult
methods.description: Verifies that extractCommand correctly extracts and trims the command after the wake word.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenGapTooShort
methods.description: Checks that extractCommand returns nil if the gap between wake word and command is too short.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNothingAfterTrigger
methods.description: Ensures extractCommand returns nil if nothing follows the trigger words.

methods.name: extractCommandIgnoresEmptyTriggers
methods.description: Tests that extractCommand ignores empty trigger strings and still correctly detects commands.
